value.account:
WHAT I CHANGED
- State and selection. RunState gained result_persistence_profile (omitted from to_dict when None; unsupported values raise ValueError naming the profile at construction, StateManager.initialize and load). The constant and the shell/witness/classification primitives live in a new stdlib-only leaf, orchestrator/pure_replay_progress.py, so state.py and the call-frame manager share one implementation. StateManager.initialize takes the profile. orchestrator run (compiled .orc) and resume --force-restart select it. calls.py selects it for a fresh, non-iterative child frame purely from the callee's validated frontend_kind == workflow_lisp (not the parent's profile). _CallFrameStateManager rejects a malformed existing frame with 'existing call-frame state' before any mkdir/write and never backfills; load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a detached RunState.
- Replay modules. pure_replay_index.py derives the index (typed addresses parsed from the binding_refs strings against the bundle projection, literal type-checking including inactive union members, cycle/duplicate-authority/identity/unbound-text/cross-frame/scope errors, SCC-based multiple_visit_region, loop-owned nodes also reported as multiple_visit_region). pure_replay_surfaces.py audits steps/pure_bundle/private_artifact_versions/checkpoint_record/restore_payload and raises profile_conflict. pure_result_replay.py holds PureReplayRuntime (cache that revalidates the exact shell or exact active result on every hit, overlay, address resolution, boundary leaf audit) and re-exports every required name including _propagate_pure_ineligibility. pure_replay_executor.py is the executor glue (visit begin/reuse, preflight before the prologue, in-memory reconstruction before the loop).
- Persistence. StateManager and _CallFrameStateManager got begin_eligible_pure_visit / reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit / settle_eligible_pure_success / settle_eligible_pure_failure (one transaction each). OutcomeRecorder.persist_step_result takes eligible_pure_settlement: success settles the shell, keeps the full result in memory and hands the shell to the summary emitter; failure/skip settles the full row. Eligible pure steps run bundle-free (execute_pure_projection(bundle_free=True)); replay_pure_projection re-derives values and maps failures to binding_unresolved / evaluation_failed / output_contract_invalid with the required cause types.
- Resume. execute() determines the restart boundary exactly once and passes it to _execute_step_loop and (as restart_node_id=) to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision; a profiled resume with nothing left to restart no longer re-enters the first node. The provider observation manager is now created when execute() starts, closed once, and not created when observation is disabled (I updated two tests in test_provider_observation_workflow.py that asserted construction-time creation).
- Checkpoints/default resume. emit_runtime_shadow_record skips eligible pure points; capture_restore_payload reads values from the validated overlay and drops bindings sourced from eligible pure steps. determine_runtime_default_resume_decision now computes the nearest prior durable boundary over a filtered view of the points (the real plan is still passed to the restore selector because program identity hashes all points), and admits VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY only with no prior durable boundary plus validated leaves and unstarted/interrupted progress; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable. The existing prior-boundary block was factored into _apply_prior_boundary_decision.
- Docs/tests. specs/state.md has a new profile section. tests/test_pure_result_replay.py (22 tests) covers state/round-trip/fail-closed load, shell and classification, the index, a clean profiled run, interrupted resume with no repeated effect, visit-two and missing-input failures, profile_conflict, zero-record default resume, child-frame selection, single restart determination and the observation lifecycle. I also ran the CLI run and --force-restart by hand.

VERIFICATION
Full suite before/after on a pristine git-archive copy: 144/140 failures pre-existing (sockets, environment, golden files) vs 140 with my change; the only new ones were the two observation-lifecycle tests, now updated. 

ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED / DISCARDED
- Putting shell/profile code in orchestrator/workflow: rejected, it causes an import cycle through workflow/__init__ -> executor -> state. Hence the leaf module.
- Filtering the runtime plan itself for default resume: rejected, the program-identity digest covers all checkpoint points so records would stop validating; I filter only for nearest-boundary selection.
- Making required nodes a minimal consumer-reachability set: rejected as unsound without parsing every node type's refs; I rebuild all derived-complete pure nodes (cheap, deterministic).
- Keeping the executor-level _determine_resume_default_resume_decision(state) signature and passing the boundary via an attribute, so existing monkeypatching tests keep working.
- Retrying a failed eligible pure node on resume is not possible under single-visit; it fails closed (progress_witness_invalid).

NOT COVERED / UNCERTAIN
- Several signatures were underspecified and are my guesses: evaluate_node(node, overlay_state) for replay_node (accepts either a result mapping or a bare artifacts mapping), resolve_bundle_path receives a str subclass carrying node_id/step_id/presentation_key, binding path is a tuple, load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a RunState, scope_kind other than 'root' is always a mismatch.
- reachability_ambiguous is raised only when a required pure node was not reached; PureResultReplayIndexError for profile_conflict propagates out of execute() (no state write) rather than becoming a failed run, so the CLI does not catch it.
- Skipped eligible nodes inside not-taken structured branches (persist_skipped_structured_descendants) were not specifically exercised or reworked; eligible nodes with publishes/consumes are treated as ineligible (my addition).
- Dashboards/monitors that read pure values out of state.json will no longer see them for profiled runs. Executor_runtime Protocols were not extended with the new state-manager methods. No commit was made.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile: state selector and automatic selection, value-free pure completion shells, a replay index and runtime, resume reconstruction, and checkpoint/default-resume filtering; the full suite has no new failures beyond the baseline's, after updating two observation-lifecycle tests to the new contract.
